riskFactors.title: Geographic Concentration Risk
riskFactors.description: 71% of portfolio concentrated in Klang Valley/Selangor region, creating regional economic exposure.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Diversification across 4 states (KL, Selangor, Penang, Johor, Perak)

aggravatingFactors.factor: High concentration in single economic region
Klang Valley property market cycles affect majority of assets

monitoringTriggers: New supply pipeline in key submarkets

riskFactors.title: Floating-Rate Debt Exposure
riskFactors.description: 44% of debt exposed to interest rate changes with moderate hedging through 56% fixed-rate debt.

aggravatingFactors.factor: BNM OPR increases directly impact 44% of debt
Average borrowing cost at 3.79% could rise

riskFactors.title: Professional Management Structure
riskFactors.description: Strong governance with institutional sponsorship from Sunway Berhad, independent board majority, and comprehensive committees.

mitigatingFactors.factor: CEO with extensive property and REIT experience

riskFactors.title: Comprehensive Disclosure
riskFactors.description: Full disclosure of portfolio metrics, segment breakdowns, and lease profiles with high transparency standards.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Detailed segment reporting (Retail, Hotel, Office, Industrial)

riskFactors.title: Lease Rollover Management
riskFactors.description: Portfolio maintains high occupancy with successful renewal rates, though hotel segment at 65% occupancy requires monitoring.

mitigatingFactors.factor: 97% retail occupancy with strong renewal rates

aggravatingFactors.factor: Hotel occupancy at 65% is below optimal

monitoringTriggers: Office lease renewals at Wisma Sunway
Retail renewal rates and reversion trends

riskFactors.title: Sponsor Relationship Quality
riskFactors.description: Strong alignment with Sunway Berhad providing pipeline access and support while maintaining arm's length transactions.

mitigatingFactors.factor: Related party transactions disclosed and managed

keyDifferences: Diversified portfolio across 4 segments vs pure retail

observations.title: Record Performance in FY2025
observations.content: Sunway REIT delivered exceptional FY2025 results with record DPU of 14.48 sen, representing 44.8% YoY growth driven by strong retail performance and strategic acquisitions.
observations.summary: 44.8% DPU growth to record 14.48 sen, RM10.2B portfolio

observations.title: Strong Debt Metrics
observations.content: Conservative 39.4% gearing with 10.6pp headroom to 50% limit. Interest coverage at healthy 4.0x with balanced 56%/44% fixed/floating debt structure.
observations.summary: 39.4% gearing, 4.0x interest cover, balanced debt structure

observations.title: Diversified Portfolio Strength
observations.content: Well-balanced portfolio across 4 segments (Retail 70%, Hotels 18%, Office 10%, Industrial 2%) with 28 properties spanning 5 states, providing natural diversification.

observations.title: Hotel Segment Monitoring
observations.content: Hotel occupancy at 65% remains below other segments (Retail 97%, Office 82%, Industrial 87%). Recovery trajectory requires monitoring given 18% portfolio contribution.
